headline: Packaging Corporation Of America (PKG) On Strong Earnings And Higher Prices Looks Fully Valued

headline: Packaging Corporation of America (PKG) Is Up 9.1% After Record Shipments And Containerboard Price Hike
summary: Packaging Corporation of America recently reported past second-quarter 2026 results showing sales rising to US$2,489.9 million while net income eased to US$192.1 million, with earnings per share lower than a year earlier despite stronger volumes and contributions from the Greif containerboard acquisition.
